correctness.rationale: The Fano incidence model has 21 edges; the induced-edge compatibility criterion exhausts all 21-choose-3 triples (84 matchings of size 3) and all 21-choose-4 candidates (none). Exact-cover branching on an uncovered edge visits every unordered partition once and returns 416; direct full automorphism actions (168 collineations plus 168 dualities) partition these into 8,16,56,112,112,112. An independently coded cyclic-difference-set enumeration reconstructed 84/416/orbit 336, so counts and boundary (seven colors) stand independently of saved log text.
residual_risks: A bounded exact enumeration proves only this finite graph, not an infinite graph family.
